subject: Dual plot and Area plot of Zoo objects

messages.author: a9636261b6be9bd1
messages.subject: Dual plot and Area plot of Zoo objects
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to generate time series plots for zoo objects.

I managed to plot 1 series. Now I want to do a dual axis plot (left
and right) for 2 series.

Also I would like to to an area polygon plot of the 1st series and
superimpose the second one as a line on top.


Is there any code for this? Has anybody written any scripts that he
could share ?

Many thanks in advance,
Costas

PS
Code:

fplot<-function(temp2)
{

qplot(index(temp2), as.vector(temp2), geom = "line",
colour=I("#3182BD"),
main="", xlab="", ylab="")
}

fplot(WAAA)

where WAAA is a zoo time series

> head(WAAA)

1962-01-05 4.43
1962-01-12 4.42
1962-01-19 4.42
1962-01-26 4.41
1962-02-02 4.42
1962-02-09 4.42

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: Dual plot and Area plot of Zoo objects
parts:
Unless the second axis is a transformation of the first then the answer is a big no.

See geom_polygon for your second question 
http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/geom_polygon.html

HTH

Luciano
